newsitem.title: USA: North Sea Brent crude trades slightly lower in US.
newsitem.headline: North Sea Brent crude trades slightly lower in US.

text.p: North Sea paper Brent cargoes traded slightly weaker for May outright deals late Friday in the U.S., according to traders.
Traders said all of the outright trades were for partial cargoes, with 100 lots moving at $19.95 a barrel, 100 lots at $19.97 and 100 lots more at $20.00 a barrel.
May IPE settled the session at an even $20.00, 19 cents lower than Thursday.
A few inter-month spreads moved, an April/May at minus 5 cents and a May/June Brent at plus 2 cents. Deals were relatively stable from the market talk all afternoon.
